name: 🚀 FastFlowLM v1.0.10 — Constrained Decoding & More Accurate Whisper
body:
This release does three things:

- **Reasoning, tool calls and structured output** are handled one way for every model on `/v1/chat/completions`.
- **`tool_choice` and `response_format` are enforced** while the model generates, not just requested.
- **Whisper transcription** is more accurate, and `/v1/audio/transcriptions` now supports `language`, `prompt` and `response_format`.

It also fixes several `flm serve` bugs, including Lemonade failing to launch FLM on Linux.

---

## ✨ New Features

### 🧩 OpenAI API: Shared Chat Parsing and Constrained Decoding

**[PR #790](https://github.com/ROCm/FastFlowLM/pull/790)**

Every model writes its answer in its own markup. Qwen3 uses `<think>` and `<tool_call>`, Gemma 4 uses a thought channel and `call:f{…}`, GPT-OSS uses Harmony channels, and LFM2 writes Python calls. Until now each model had its own parser for this. In v1.0.10, one shared parser handles all of them, so `/v1/chat/completions` returns the same OpenAI-shaped message whatever the model:

- `reasoning_content`, `content` and `tool_calls` are split the same way for every model, streamed or not.
- The streamed deltas add up to exactly the non-streamed reply.
- Tool-call markup counts as a call only when the request includes `tools`. A reply that is only tool calls has `content: null`, as in the OpenAI API.
